specification.input_notes: GSE103236 is the GEO accession. The deposit contains a quantile-calibrated expression matrix for 19 gastric samples; it is unclear whether this is raw or processed data and whether it is the exact input for Table 1.

specification.comparison_metric: Exact match of the reported numeric strings for P.Value, adj.P.Val, and logFC for NFE2L3.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Counts exact; scalars within displayed rounding bin; p values at reported precision; proportions by numerator/denominator; performance metrics on the identical split.
specification.specification_gaps: The differential expression method, normalization, multiple-testing correction, and whether the deposited matrix is the exact input are not specified.
specification.alternatives_considered: The TCGA analysis (Figure 1a-b) was considered but rejected because the TCGA data are not in the deposit listing; the GSE103236 Table 1 result is the first reported quantitative result and uses the deposited data.
